content:
I’m excited to share this previously unreleased 2022 conversation between Charlie Munger and Todd Combs. 

Public Release: Oct 6th.
Members have access now.
Join us.

As with any Munger talk, the subjects are both deep and wide. I’ve pulled out the ideas that most resonated with me. You’ll learn how Munger recognized people worth betting on, chose problems worth solving, and turned a long attention span into an unfair advantage.

I also unpack one of Berkshire’s most underappreciated (and unnoticed) strengths: positioning themselves to master their circumstances rather than be mastered by them. 

A special thank you to the Singleton Foundation, Todd Combs, and William Thorndike for giving me the permission to share this with you.
